title: Does GGT–urate context add diastolic-pressure information? An exploratory cross-wave prediction test
abstract: In exploratory temporal transport from NHANES2009–2010 to2015–2016 adults (n=4,799 and4,434), a logGGT×urate product did not establish improved diastolic-pressure prediction beyond flexible routine measures: added-minus-baseline weighted MSE=-0.041377mmHg², joint survey-PSU bootstrap95% interval[-0.342672,0.225509].
